arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Customs tariff net receipts for 1974 (monthly values in millions)
values = [304, 239, 277, 286, 295, 301, 325, 355, 305, 347, 319, 307]

# Population standard deviation
n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n

# Population variance (using N, not N-1)
variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in values) / n
std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)

# Coefficient of variation
cv = (std_dev / mean) * 100

print(f"Values: {values}")
print(f"Mean: {mean}")
print(f"Population Std Dev: {std_dev}")
print(f"CV: {cv}")
print(f"CV rounded to hundredths: {round(cv, 2)}")
EOF
